steps.instruction: Cross the tail over the standing part to form a loop.
steps.done_looks_like: The blue rope forms one open loop with the tail crossing across the standing part.

checks.text: The rope forms a single open loop with the working end crossing over the standing part

common_mistakes: No closed loop is formed, rope hangs straight
Tail crosses under instead of over the standing part
Loop is twisted closed with no open space

steps.instruction: Pass the tail behind and around the standing part.
steps.done_looks_like: The blue rope shows an upper twist with the tail sticking out sideways behind the standing part.

checks.text: The working end passes behind the standing part forming an upper twist

common_mistakes: Tail stays in front and does not go behind the standing part
Loop collapses with no visible twist
Tail points down instead of out sideways

steps.instruction: Thread the tail through the lower loop and tighten.
steps.done_looks_like: The blue rope forms a tight figure-eight with two stacked loops and a short tail below.

checks.text: The rope forms a figure-8 with the tail threaded through the lower loop
The knot is dressed and tightened into a clear 8 shape

common_mistakes: Tail misses the lower loop and hangs outside the knot
Knot looks like a simple overhand with only one loop
Knot stays loose and sloppy instead of tightened
